item.title: Letters to The Province: Proactive efforts could help prevent future tragedy
item.description: Re: Eby says it looks like OpenAI could have prevented “horrific” Tumbler Ridge killings. Mass shootings are traumatic events causing intense fear and grief, yet they present critical opportunities for societal, legislative, and psychological intervention.
